label: Matt 13:1
text: On that day Jesus went out of the house, and sat by the seaside.

label: Matt 13:2
text: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.

label: Matt 13:3
text:
He spoke to them many things in parables, saying,
“Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

label: Matt 13:4
text: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

label: Matt 13:5
text: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

label: Matt 13:6
text: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

label: Matt 13:7
text: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

label: Matt 13:8
text: Others fell on good soil, and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

label: Matt 13:9
text: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

label: Matt 13:10
text: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

label: Matt 13:11
text:
He answered them,
“To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

label: Matt 13:12
text: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

label: Matt 13:13
text: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

label: Matt 13:14
text:
In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says,

‘By hearing you will hear,
and will in no way understand;
Seeing you will see,
and will in no way perceive:

label: Matt 13:15
Matt 13:16
text: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

label: Matt 13:17
text: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

label: Matt 13:18
text: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

label: Matt 13:19
text: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom, and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes, and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

label: Matt 13:20
text: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word, and immediately with joy receives it;

label: Matt 13:21
text: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

label: Matt 13:22
text: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

label: Matt 13:23
text: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word, and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit, and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”

label: Matt 13:24
text:
He set another parable before them, saying,
“The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

label: Matt 13:25
text:
but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds
also among the wheat, and went away.

label: Matt 13:26
text: But when the blade sprang up and produced fruit, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

label: Matt 13:27
text: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’

label: Matt 13:28
text:
“He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’
“The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’

label: Matt 13:29
text: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

label: Matt 13:30
text: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”

label: Matt 13:31
text:
He set another parable before them, saying,
“The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field;

label: Matt 13:32
text: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”

label: Matt 13:33
text:
He spoke another parable to them.
“The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures
of meal, until it was all leavened.”

label: Matt 13:34
text: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,

label: Matt 13:35
Matt 13:36
text: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”

label: Matt 13:37
text:
He answered them,
“He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

label: Matt 13:38
text: the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the children of the Kingdom; and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

label: Matt 13:39
text: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

label: Matt 13:40
text: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

label: Matt 13:41
text: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling, and those who do iniquity,

label: Matt 13:42
text: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

label: Matt 13:43
text: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

label: Matt 13:44
text: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found, and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.

label: Matt 13:45
text: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

label: Matt 13:46
text: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

label: Matt 13:47
text: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet, that was cast into the sea, and gathered some fish of every kind,

label: Matt 13:48
text: which, when it was filled, they drew up on the beach. They sat down, and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

label: Matt 13:49
text: So will it be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

label: Matt 13:50
text: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.”

label: Matt 13:51
text:
Jesus said to them,
“Have you understood all these things?”

They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

label: Matt 13:52
text:
He said to them,
“Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

label: Matt 13:53
text: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

label: Matt 13:54
text: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom, and these mighty works?

label: Matt 13:55
text: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers, James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

label: Matt 13:56
text: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

label: Matt 13:57
text:
They were offended by him.
But Jesus said to them,
“A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and in his own house.”

label: Matt 13:58
text: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

statement: In Galilean sowing, some seed fell on the path (eaten by birds) and on rocky ground with too little soil, where it sprang up quickly but withered under the sun for lack of root

statement: Seed sown among thorns was choked by the thorns as they grew up

statement: Good soil could yield a crop of thirty, sixty or a hundred times what was sown

statement: Matthew cites Isaiah 6:9-10 ('By hearing you will hear... and will in no way understand') as fulfilled in the crowds' dull response

statement: At harvest the darnel was gathered first, bound in bundles and burned, and the wheat gathered into the barn

statement: A man sowed a mustard seed in his field: mustard was raised by sowing seed in fields, not gardens

statement: The sown mustard grew greater than the herbs and became a tree, so that the birds of the air lodged in its branches

statement: A woman hid leaven in three measures (sata, three se'ahs) of meal until the whole batch was leavened

label: Treasure hidden in a field
statement: Valuables were hidden in the ground of a field, and a man who found treasure hid it again and bought the field

label: A merchant seeking fine pearls
statement: A merchant sought fine pearls, and pearls of great price were bought with everything a man had

label: A dragnet gathering fish of every kind
statement: A dragnet (seine) cast into the sea gathered fish of every kind and was drawn up on the beach when filled

label: Good fish into containers, bad thrown away
statement: Fishermen sat on the beach, put the good fish into containers and threw the bad away

label: A scribe bringing out treasures new and old
statement: A scribe made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a householder bringing out of his treasure things new and old

label: His own country was Nazareth
statement: Jesus's 'own country', where he came and taught, was Nazareth, a village of first-century Galilee

label: Teaching in the Nazareth synagogue
statement: Jesus taught the Nazareth crowd in their synagogue

label: The carpenter's son (tekton)
statement: Jesus was known as 'the carpenter's son' - the son of a tekton, a building craftsman

label: His mother called Mary
statement: Jesus's mother was called Mary

label: Brothers James, Joses, Simon and Judas
statement: Jesus's brothers were called James, Joses, Simon and Judas

label: His sisters with us
statement: Jesus had sisters who lived among the Nazareth villagers

label: A prophet without honour in his own country
statement: A prophet is not without honour except in his own country and in his own house
